inspection_protocol: Inspect one bounded whole carrier per case, then at most one source-informed row/block crop and one native-resolution target detail for each. Keep orientation. Choose crop coordinates adaptively from that carrier, record native rectangles/URLs/dimensions/bytes/hashes and viewing resizes. Retain both attempts and failed mappings, without replacements or silent additional leaves.
limits: Dependent contribution remains draft until196acceptance and prerequisite-aware integration. No held178/191 update, verification promotion, pixel/PDF/font republication, independent/untouched evaluation, source preference, decipherment or translation.
observation_scope: Record broad provisional row/illustration geometry around the annotated gap, distinguishing source claims from visible shapes. P0 ordinals are source order, not certified physical rows. Do not choose a preferred source, transcribe fresh glyphs, assign exact word masks, correct data or promote corpus-join readiness.
rights: Link Yale source URLs; public access does not establish an open image license. Image bytes and IIIF metadata caches remain local.
